canonical_command: case participant role add CASE --participant P --role R
invariant: does not link Principal or grant Review implicitly

canonical_command: case participant link-principal CASE --principal P --participant C
invariant: authenticated Principal distinct from Case Participant
roles and links derive from canonical CaseState

canonical_command: case provider attach CASE --participant P --endpoint URL --model ID
invariant: Participant must genuinely exist/admit; no hidden role escalation
